title: New Jersey's 11th Congressional District Regular Election, 2026
description: The regular general election for New Jersey's 11th congressional district will be held November 3, 2026. The seat is currently held by Democratic incumbent Analilia Mejia, who won the April 2026 special election to fill the vacancy left by now-Governor Mikie Sherrill. Mejia, a progressive former labor organizer and Bernie Sanders 2020 campaign operative, won the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026 with roughly 82% of the vote. She faces Republican Joe Hathaway, a Randolph Township councilman and former mayor who ran unopposed in the GOP primary. The race is a rematch of the April 2026 special election, which Mejia won 60% to 39%.

candidates.name: Analilia Mejia
candidates.summary: Analilia Mejia is an Afro Latina mom, grassroots organizer, and nationally recognized advocate for working families who currently serves as the U.S. Representative for New Jersey's 11th congressional district, having won an April 2026 special election. She began her career as a union organizer, served as executive director of New Jersey Working Families Alliance where she led the fights for a $15 minimum wage and paid sick leave, was national political director for Bernie Sanders' 2020 presidential campaign, and later served as co-executive director of the Center for Popular Democracy. Mejia has called for abolishing ICE and has advocated resistance to what she describes as rising authoritarianism.

candidates.name: Joe Hathaway
candidates.summary: Joe Hathaway is a Randolph Township councilman and former mayor running for Congress in New Jersey's 11th district. A graduate of Yale University where he played varsity football earning All-Ivy League honors, Hathaway began his career in state government as an advance aide to former New Jersey Governor Chris Christie and has spent over a decade in corporate affairs and communications in the healthcare and financial services sectors. He was appointed to the Randolph Township Council in May 2022, elected in November 2022, and served as Mayor in 2025, where he focused on affordable housing settlements, road resurfacing, police staffing, and taxpayer savings.
